analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: The objective is to modernize the codebase with a focus on implementing caching mechanisms using Anthropic cache_control and OpenAI auto-prefix cache.
requirements_understanding: The modernization involves integrating caching strategies to improve performance.
The focus is on using specific caching technologies: Anthropic cache_control and OpenAI auto-prefix cache.
The solution must include error handling and observability requirements.
Measurable non-functional requirements must be defined.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement caching layers using Anthropic cache_control and OpenAI auto-prefix cache.
Ensure the system is observable with clear error handling mechanisms.
Define performance metrics to measure caching effectiveness.
clarifications_requested: Specific use cases or scenarios where caching should be applied.
Detailed requirements for error handling and observability.

executive_summary: This project aims to modernize the MagicBox platform by integrating advanced caching mechanisms to enhance performance and reliability.

functional_requirements.title: Integrate Anthropic Cache Control
functional_requirements.description: Implement Anthropic cache_control to manage caching effectively across the application.
acceptance_criteria: Caching is applied to all high-traffic modules.
Cache invalidation policies are defined and implemented.
System performance improves by at least 30% in cached operations.

functional_requirements.title: Implement OpenAI Auto-Prefix Cache
functional_requirements.description: Use OpenAI auto-prefix cache to optimize data retrieval and storage.
acceptance_criteria: Data retrieval times are reduced by 40% in targeted modules.
Cache hit rate is above 85%.
Cache is automatically updated with data changes.

functional_requirements.title: Define Error Handling for Caching
functional_requirements.description: Implement robust error handling mechanisms for caching operations.
acceptance_criteria: All caching errors are logged with sufficient detail.
System recovers gracefully from cache failures.
Error notifications are sent to the monitoring system.

functional_requirements.title: Enhance Observability
functional_requirements.description: Ensure the caching system is fully observable with monitoring and logging.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time monitoring of cache performance is available.
Logs provide detailed insights into cache operations.
Alerts are configured for cache performance anomalies.

functional_requirements.title: Cache Configuration Management
functional_requirements.description: Provide a configuration management interface for caching settings.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can update cache settings without downtime.
Configuration changes are logged and auditable.
System validates configuration changes before applying.

functional_requirements.title: Cache Security
functional_requirements.description: Ensure caching mechanisms adhere to security standards.
acceptance_criteria: Cache data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Access controls are implemented for cache management.
Security audits are conducted bi-annually.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance Improvement
non_functional_requirements.description: The system should exhibit improved performance due to caching.
non_functional_requirements.metric: System performance improves by 30% in cached operations.
acceptance_criteria: Measure performance before and after caching implementation.
Ensure a 30% improvement in response times for cached operations.
NFR-001 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability of Caching System
non_functional_requirements.description: The caching system should be reliable and fault-tolerant.
acceptance_criteria: Implement redundancy and failover mechanisms.
Monitor cache uptime continuously.
NFR-002 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security of Cached Data
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure cached data is secure and protected against unauthorized access.
acceptance_criteria: Implement encryption for cache data.
Conduct security audits regularly.
NFR-003 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability of Caching Infrastructure
non_functional_requirements.description: The caching system should scale with increased load.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Cache infrastructure scales to handle 5× current load.
acceptance_criteria: Test scalability under increased load conditions.
Ensure no degradation in cache performance.
NFR-004 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Load test with incremental load increases.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability of Cache Management Interface
non_functional_requirements.description: The cache management interface should be user-friendly.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Admin tasks are completed with no more than 3 clicks.
acceptance_criteria: Conduct usability testing with admin users.
Gather feedback and iterate on interface design.
NFR-005 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Usability testing with targeted user feedback.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.
